reset_roster_policy: Exactly13 unique readable non-command registers. Compare every defined bit with own reset, including CR1.ACCESS/WINDOW and all controls, before treating reset-default SOURCE0 as unused. Exclude WO KEY and R1W0 ICR.
read_policy: Read controls first. If any controls differ from the reset snapshot, reject inherited RTC state before reading time/calendar registers. Never reset RTC, unlock KEY, open ACCESS, clear ICR or write RTC while checking admission.
wake_policy: RTC_CR2.AWTEN and AWTSRC0..3 use RTCCLK/2,/4,/8,/16 without START. Only AWTSRC4..7 require RTC1Hz and START1. START0 alone never proves RTC is idle.
retention_policy: Any nonreset readable RTC snapshot, for every SOURCE value, conservatively blocks a new disabled LSE start. Enabled exact-source reuse does not inspect or rewrite RTC. A pristine reset SOURCE0 alone does not establish an active consumer.
no_claims: No LSE automatic enable inferred from SDK absence.
No software reset used to manufacture a pristine RTC.
No dynamic source switching, calibration, RTC compensation or clock output configuration qualified.
compensation_policy: Own x030 RM CN2.5 PDF180/printed179 table12-3 has COMPEN.EN=1 and RTC1HZ=01 producing LSE-compensated 1Hz independent of CR1.SOURCE. Disabled-source startup requires the complete pristine RTC snapshot for every SOURCE value. Read CR0/CR1/CR2/IER/ISR first with short-circuit rejection before COMPEN or calendar reads, avoiding running WINDOW/ACCESS transactions. Never rewrite compensation or its output routes.
